content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-193. - Notification of abatement proceedings.

faqs.a:
The owner of the property defaced by graffiti vandalism, which is located within the
               city, shall be notified of such graffiti vandalism by the city prior to abatement
               procedures. Service of the notice may be by first class mail properly addressed to
               the dwelling or building located on the lot or tract of land upon which the graffiti
               vandalism occurs, by a conspicuous posting of the written notice upon the dwelling
               or building located on the lot or tract of land upon which the graffiti vandalism
               occurs, or by personal service upon a natural person ever the age of 18 years who
               occupies a dwelling or building or tract of land upon which graffiti vandalism occurs.
               If a notice of graffiti vandalism cannot be served in any of the aforementioned ways,
               the notice shall be sent by first class mail to the owner of record of such lot or
               tract of land as shown in the records of the county. The notice shall be in written
               form and shall contain a:
(1)
Description of the property upon which the graffiti vandalism occurred and a description
                  of the nature of the vandalism.
(2)
Demand that the owner remove or eradicate the graffiti vandalism from the property
                  within ten days from the date of such notice.
(3)
Statement that the owner may voluntarily agree to immediate removal or eradication
                  of the graffiti vandalism by the city, with the costs assessed against the property
                  owner.
(4)
Statement that warns that the owner's failure or refusal to remove or eradicate the
                  graffiti vandalism may result in commencement of abatement procedures by the city,
                  and if all costs of such abatement, including administrative costs, attorney's fees,
                  and court or hearing costs, is not paid to the city within 30 days after a notice
                  of assessment is mailed to the property owner, such costs will be recorded as a statement
                  of lien with the appropriate county clerk and recorder and may be assessed as a lien
                  against the property pursuant to the provisions of
chapter 59
entitled "municipal liens."
(5)
Statement that the owner may make written demand to the code enforcement department
                  for a hearing before abatement procedures are commenced. The hearing shall be conducted
                  by the city manager, or his designee, provided the written demand for such hearing
                  is made within ten days from the date of the notice of nuisance, and provided the
                  written demand for a hearing contains the owner's current address and a telephone
                  number where such owner can be reached between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m.,
                  Monday through Friday. Written demand for a hearing shall be sent to the Code Enforcement
                  Supervisor, City of Arvada, 8101 Ralston Road, Arvada, Colorado 80002.
(Code 1981, § 20-52; Ord. No. 3455, § 3, 7-6-1998;
Ord. No. 4042, § 3, 12-11-2006
)
